# Sandbox lifecycle fixture

## Objective

issues.title: Provide a fixture response
issues.text:
# Fixture response

## Objective
Provide a predictable sample response.

## Requirements
Return the word READY.

## Success criteria
The response equals READY.

## Evidence required
A response check covering success and failure.

## Dependencies
None.
